title: Five Navy Bombers Vanished… Then the Rescue Plane Vanished Too ✈️ Flight 19 #shorts
youtube_description:
Five Navy bombers vanished in the Bermuda Triangle. Then the plane sent to find them vanished too. ✈️🌊

Flight 19, 5 December 1945. The flight leader radioed that both his compasses had stopped working. 27 men were lost in one night. The Navy's final verdict: "causes or reasons unknown." It helped create the legend of the Bermuda Triangle.

What do you think happened to Flight 19? 👇

Illustrated reconstruction, no real photos. Original music.
